test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Absurd
solution:
The correct answer is '**Sensible**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** antonym for the given word '**Absurd**' is '**Sensible**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Absurd**' is '**wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate**'.
 
• The meaning of the word '**Sensible**' is '**done or chosen in accordance with wisdom or prudence; likely to be of benefit**'.
 
• Hence, the appropriate answer is '**Sensible**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Amaze**- surprise (someone) greatly; fill with astonishment.
 
• **Anxious**- feeling or showing worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.
 
• **Ramble**- talk or write at length in a confused or inconsequential way.
